# Video deliverables

- [`it-hr-help-desk-triage.mp4`](https://github.com/anujb-msft/voice-ai-template-gallery/releases/download/demo-films/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mp4) — narrated demo film (5:57), on the [`demo-films`](https://github.com/anujb-msft/voice-ai-template-gallery/releases/tag/demo-films) release
- [`poster.webp`](./poster.webp) — poster image
- [`captions.vtt`](./captions.vtt) — captions for every spoken line
- [`transcript.md`](./transcript.md) — transcript with timecodes

The film opens on the caller's problem and how the template is built, then runs the
template's own demo console through 4 scripted calls, and closes on what is under the
hood and how to make it yours. Subtitles are burned in; the same lines are in
`captions.vtt`.

## Production details

- **Runtime:** 357.5 seconds (5:57), 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264 High with 48 kHz
  stereo AAC-LC audio.
- **Voices:** all 48 lines are performed by Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime
  (`gpt-realtime`) through Azure AI Voice Live (api-version `2026-04-10`): `cedar` (Narrator), `marin` (Agent), `alloy` (Sam).
- **Console:** the template's demo console from [`code/`](../code/), running in
  simulation mode and driven by its presenter script (`code/public/beats.js`). Pauses
  while the narrator speaks are trimmed; the console is filmed as it runs, not recreated.
- **Motion graphics:** a HyperFrames composition generated by
  [`scripts/video`](../../../../scripts/video/) from [`films/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mjs`](../../../../scripts/video/films/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mjs).
- **Mix:** voices only, at -16.3 LUFS integrated (target -16); a soft ring opens
  the film. No music or noise bed.

Callers, companies and phone numbers are fictional, and every voice is synthetic. The film
demonstrates a reference implementation in simulation mode; it is not a recording of a
production deployment.
